task_description: Extend the Class To-Do Board (React + TS + Vite + Supabase) per the FINAL design.md: a new 0003 migration (events, task_completions, absence_requests, absence_attachments, reviewers + enums, GRANTs, RLS, storage.objects policies, publication, replica identity), top navigation across Board/Absences/Reviewers, officer-managed events, per-account personal task tracker, month calendar, private-attachment absences workflow, and a shared-reviewers page.
